title: STILL PRESENT (r3): wrong-person awaiting UPDATE still runs via unguarded update_reference_call_status — the guarded SQL is never wired, and the race pin is vacuous
evidence: form_handler.gleam:1235-1250: "case row.taken_over_at != "" { True -> wisp.redirect(to: "/reference/" <> token) False -> case row.correction_cycles >= 1 { True -> exhaust_wrong_person(...) False -> case sql.update_reference_call_status( config.db, id_uuid, sql.AwaitingCorrection, "", "contact_invalid", sql.ContactInitiated, )" — update_reference_call_status.sql:22-24: "WHERE id = $1 AND status = $5::reference_call_status" (no taken_over_at clause); mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person.sql carries "AND taken_over_at IS NULL" but grep shows zero src callers; test:1744-1746: "// Take-over lands between the wrong-person read and the UPDATE. actions_handler.do_take_over(...) |> should.equal(200) ... let assert Ok(returned) = rc_sql.mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person(db, call)" — the guarded SQL invoked DIRECTLY, never via the POST route
detail: The executed wrong-person transition still calls the unguarded update_reference_call_status (WHERE id + status only); the guarded SQL exists but is never called by the handler, and the pin calls it directly, so rewiring to the unguarded path keeps CI green. Both blocker conditions unmet.
recommended_fix: Call sql.mark_awaiting_correction_wrong_person in apply_wrong_person's awaiting branch; rewrite the pin to drive the POST /reference/:token/wrong-person route with a take-over committing between lookup and UPDATE (neutralizing the backstop must turn it red).

title: webhooks exhaust_row swallows a DB error on the exhaustion UPDATE — same swallow class r3 N13 fixed in form_handler, never fixed here
detail: The catch-all `_` arm conflates a 0-row (concurrent writer, correct stand-down) with a DB Error: a failing exhaust_reference_call is acked silently — no Sentry capture, no log, no notification. Provider retries self-heal, but the error is invisible.
recommended_fix: Split the arm: Ok(Returned(_, [])) -> Nil; Error(err) -> capture a ReferenceWebhookExhaustFailed Sentry event, mirroring exhaust_wrong_person's r3 N13 fix.

title: W3 co-nudge producer side unpinned — nothing asserts the sweep writes the kind tag; only the consumer exclusion is pinned (hand-written shape)
evidence: sweep.gleam: "json.array([co_nudge_entry(outcome, now_iso)], fn(e) { e })" — sweep integration test: "summary.co_nudged |> should.equal(1) row_attempt_count(db, row_id) |> should.equal(2) // One co-nudge attempt entry (email channel, to the applicant). attempts_length(db, row_id) |> should.equal(1)" — no kind assertion; co_nudge_bounce_stands_down_test hand-writes '{"detail":"co_nudge_send_1","kind":"co_nudge"}' into attempts

title: Rewritten find_reference_call_by_send_ref: malformed-'at' regex branch (r3 N14sql fix) has no test
evidence: "COALESCE(( SELECT CASE WHEN e->>'at' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}[T ][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}' THEN (e->>'at')::timestamptz >= rc.corrected_at ELSE false END ...), false) AS send_is_post_correction" — no test constructs an attempts entry with a malformed at value; all integration fixtures use valid RFC3339 strings
detail: The guarded cast is the r3 N14sql fix (a malformed 'at' must stand the event down, not raise). Untested: a regression to the unguarded cast (or to 'raise on malformed') would not be caught, and a malformed-at post-correction bounce silently never exhausts.
recommended_fix: Add an integration case seeding an attempts entry with a malformed 'at' (e.g. 'not-a-date') and assert the delivery-failure event stands down without raising or exhausting.
